data.assessment: Under the rush load (228 orders), the town delivered 223.8 on time with 0 unfinished. The worst company's on-time rate is 0.97, well above the provisional 0.7 floor. The remaining 4.2 late deliveries are almost all pickup-deadline misses (4.0). Road friction is still large: blocked time is 936 s against the 600 s target, and A carries 476 s of it even though A never waits on the road. B and C do all the road waiting (52.6 and 48.0 waits), which produces 13.4 overstays and 14.6 blocking evictions; C's penalty of 21.1 is the main drag on its utility of 56.3.

proposals.title: Shorten hold_limit 60s -> 50s
proposals.rationale: Robots parked at intersection 8 still block for 936 s in total, mostly hurting A (476 s), and the residual late deliveries are pickup misses during the rush. Releasing parked robots 10 s earlier should cut blocked time and could recover a few of the 4.0 pickup misses. Main-goal gains will be small (+1 to +3), so the min_improvement check may decide it. Expected vote: A yes; B and C likely no, because more overstays raise their penalties. Expect a 1-2 split unless measured gains offset their penalties.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 50s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 2 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"

proposals.title: Tighten block_k 2 -> 1
proposals.rationale: In period 1, block_k 3->2 cut late deliveries sharply, yet blocked time is still 936 s with 14.6 blocking evictions. Evicting a parked robot as soon as one robot waits behind it should cut A's 476 s of blocking further. The risk is that evicted B and C robots return to the depot and miss pickup deadlines during the rush, so the measured change in on-time deliveries and late pickups decides it. Expected vote: A yes; B and C likely no because Major eviction penalties would rise.

proposals.why_human: This would be the second step in a row that shifts road costs onto B and C, who do all the road waiting. The human said C's utility should be re-measured after the last override. If B and C vote no, adopting this would again override the vote, so the human should decide whether the throughput gain justifies it.
